args.title: Ironbark Tooling newsletter — Cold-chain logistics in 2026 (summary)
args.body:
Sources: Ironbark Tooling newsletter ("Cold-chain logistics in 2026"), article at blog.ironbark.example/2026/cold-chain, and its companion piece at insights.ironbark.example/cold-chain/companion.

- Where carriers shared live sensor data, temperature excursions fell 30%.
- Most of the savings came from fewer rejected loads rather than from less spoilage.
- The companion piece reports that pilots cut claims by about a quarter (25%).
